<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Home Services Complaint Form">48531a92c3e26e10ca67153ed40131e9</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:ca9e61aec3a6ae10ca67153ed40131d9</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Validate Attachment</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onSubmit() {
  var fileName = g_form.getValue('supporting_documents'); // Replace with your actual variable name


  if (!fileName) {
    g_form.showFieldMsg('supporting_documents', 'Please attach a file.', 'error');
    return false;
  }

  fileName = fileName.toLowerCase();
  alert(fileName);
  var extension = fileName.substring(fileName.lastIndexOf('.') + 1);
	alert(extension);
  var allowedExtensions = ['pdf', 'png', 'jpeg'];

  if (!allowedExtensions.includes(extension)) {
    g_form.showFieldMsg('supporting_documents', 'Only PDF, PNG, or JPEG files are allowed.', 'error');
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}
